summary: Read a list of integers in which all values differ. Write every ordering those integers can form. Two orderings are different as soon as some position holds a different integer. Inside any one ordering, each integer appears exactly once, no more and no less. The ordering that matches the input must be included along with every rearrangement. Write all of those orderings.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
